updater_diagnostic.old_parser: Strip HTML tags, find a date, scan the next 260 characters, then take the first five strictly increasing tokens in 1..40.
updater_diagnostic.root_cause: The parser associates numbers by proximity in flattened page text rather than by the result cell belonging to the same contest row. The generic dataset audit validates shape and ranges but not source-row provenance.

q60.reason: The official archive page does not yet publish the 315 combination; the existing paired freezes remain pending.

quantitative_hypothesis.statement: A parser that binds a date and exactly five valid sorted numbers to cells in the same table row will reject incomplete contest rows and unrelated numbers elsewhere in the page.
quantitative_hypothesis.acceptance_rule: The first cell must contain one supported Italian date; the second cell must contain exactly five distinct ascending integers in 1..40; no look-ahead outside the row is permitted.
quantitative_hypothesis.test_plan: Six deterministic unit tests: valid row, pending row with nearby unrelated numbers, script numbers outside the row, six-token result cell, invalid ordering/range/duplicates, conflicting duplicate date.
quantitative_hypothesis.reason: The newly appended 315 row has unresolved official-source provenance. Running a new predictive walk-forward or scoring the next target on this archive would risk training on an unverified outcome.
